notes.content: Direct plane from Tallinn to Budapest is the best, just 2 hours and you are there.
Checked in to our appartment, had some snacks and went to sleep. Will explore the city in the morning
Woke up and went for some local cousine breakfast, absolute delight. Prices are good too
Went to really posh looking cafe for a golden coffee
Had a lovely meal and decided to check out famous bars. This particular is called Szimpla Kert it has 2 floors and has lots of rooms , feels like a maze full of bars and people
Today is Elmas birthday so we decided to start our day with famous spas. It s massive building with lots of saunas and outside hot swimming pool. This was amazing, you can spend entire day there
Then decided to walk around castle and straight to irish bar for some guiness pie and guiness, needles to say

Last day in this lovely city and to make things even worse i have just seen Travis Fimmel one of my favourite actors . I have been one hand shake away from him but hesitated and thought for a second its not him. Then verified it was him after googling and rushed after him but it was to late. Vould not find him.
